messages:
Aisha: Quick ping — final prep for tomorrow's backend panel. Two asks: confirm who is scribing debrief + whether we need candidate consent for recording.
Sam: I can scribe if no one else has claimed it. what time is the panel again?
Marta: 10:30am PT in #interview-rooms and Zoom link is in the calendar invite (I've updated it). Candidate asked earlier about recording — I replied asking permission; no reply yet.
Raju: If candidate doesn't respond, we should not record. We can take notes in the shared doc instead.
Aisha: Agreed on no recording without explicit consent. Sam — thx for scribing. Can you capture quick ratings per rubric and any blockers?
Sam: Yep. I'll use the standard debrief template. Quick Q: do we want the technical score to be out of 10 or 5 for this role?
Raju: 10 please — gives more granularity for tie-breakers.
Aisha: OK 10. Also please capture a short one-line follow-up ask (e.g., "needs deeper async on system design") if anything pops up.
Marta: FYI I've attached the candidate's take-home in the calendar and pre-read link in the doc: https://docs.internal/recruiting/panel-prep.
Sam: Thanks — can someone paste the rubric snippet I should copy into the notes?
Aisha: Use this header in the doc (copy/paste):

```
Rubric:
- Technical (0-10)
- System Design (0-10)
- Communication (0-5)
- Collaboration / Culture addendum (0-5)
- Overall Recommend: Strong Yes / Yes / No / Strong No
```

Aisha: Also quick logistics: please join 5 mins early, mute mic until candidate starts, and have questions prioritized (we aim for 45m total).
Raju: I'll take the first system design block. Sam — if you want, we can split scribe + timekeeper?
Sam: I'll scribe and timekeep. Happy to hand off if someone prefers only to interview.
Marta: Candidate consent came through: they said okay to record the session. I've updated the invite and pinged them to confirm a11y needs.
Aisha: Awesome. One last thing — for any flag (cheating, red-flag behavior), tag @people-ops immediately so we can triage.
Sam: Got it. See you all at 10:25am. :thumbsup:
hirebot: Calendar event updated by Marta — panel attendees: Aisha, Sam, Raju, Marta.
Aisha: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick responses.
